website privacy / 14 November 2026

Your details.
Your choice.

This notice covers the Kiln website and its enquiry forms, operated by the Kiln team at Porto Labs.

What we collect

Registration collects your email, optional hardware preference and consent to Kiln product and launch updates. Contact enquiries collect your email, optional organisation, enquiry topic and message. We also record the time and privacy-notice version associated with a submission.

Why we use it

We use registration details to send the updates you explicitly request, based on your consent. We use contact details to respond to your enquiry and manage that conversation, based on our legitimate interest in answering people who contact us. Contacting us does not subscribe you to marketing.

Where it goes

Formspree processes form submissions for the Kiln team. Our website host processes routine connection information. The booking page embeds Google Calendar, which processes appointment details. Read Formspree’s privacy policy and Google’s privacy policy. The website has no advertising trackers or third-party analytics scripts. We do not sell form submissions or provide them to other businesses for their own marketing.

How long we keep it

We keep update registrations while you remain subscribed. We review unresolved enquiries after 12 months and remove details no longer needed. If you unsubscribe, we stop marketing use and retain a minimal record of your preference so it can be respected. This website does not collect payment or card details.

Change your mind

To stop updates, email richard@portolabs.xyz. You can also contact us below to request access, correction, deletion or restriction, or to object to how your details are used. We may need to verify a request before releasing or deleting information.

You can raise a concern with the UK Information Commissioner’s Office. This website notice is separate from the privacy design goals of the Kiln hardware and software.
